propositions: _lib_writes.py is at the 800-line hard cap imposed by the module-size-limit gate and cannot accept new arguments to create_ticket without relief

The file bundles seven independent concerns: genesis, identity & key material, status lifecycle, leaf mutations, session logs, store maintenance, and signing, which should be separated by concern rather than by direction
The split must produce three modules each sized between 100 and 500 lines, with _lib_writes kept to ~378 lines holding only genesis and status lifecycle concerns

All 27 public names currently exported from _lib_writes must remain resolvable as both rebar.<name> and rebar._lib_writes.<name> via re-export blocks, so __init__.py and _lib_gates.py require no changes
The move is behaviour-preserving; all function bodies relocate byte-identically with no logic rewritten, verified by reconstructing and diffing the pre-split module's 31 top-level blocks
